About EZR

Getting dressed is part of everyday life. For people navigating skin sensitivities, shopping can mean a lot of extra research. EZR makes clothing details easier to explore in one place.

We connect the city wardrobe with an understanding of its materials, using technology to make personal choices more informed.

01 / Discover

Start with what you need.

Search ordinary words. Choose materials you prefer or want to avoid, without a long questionnaire.

02 / Understand

Know why it appears.

Matches come from product fields and your choices. Unknown information stays visible.

03 / Explore

Keep your preferences.

Find similar garments in the same category. Your material exclusions stay in place.

Learn about materials +

Material names describe fibers, not a guarantee about how a finished garment will feel on your skin. Natural origin alone does not establish suitability or overall environmental impact.

Natural fibers

Cotton, linen, hemp, wool and silk. The fiber source is one part of a garment’s story.

Processed fibers

Viscose, modal and lyocell. These fibers are manufactured through processing cellulose.

Synthetic fibers

Polyester, nylon and elastane. Blends combine fibers, so check each percentage and the trims.

EZR uses the recorded composition. It does not infer softness, stretch, breathability or skin compatibility from an illustration.

Caution: Not medical advice

EZR helps you discover clothing based on product information and preferences you select. It does not diagnose eczema, identify your medical triggers, guarantee skin compatibility, or medically certify garments. Individual sensitivities vary. Verify product details with the retailer and consult a qualified healthcare professional for personalized medical advice.

Products are sold and shipped by the linked retailers. Prices exclude tax and shipping; offers may have conditions. Check the retailer for current availability and returns. Garment sketches are original artwork; product photos are available on the retailer’s page.

Your choices stay here. Searches and preferences are kept in this page’s memory and reset on reload. Only dismissal of the introductory notice is saved in this browser. There is no login, symptom questionnaire or external analysis service.
